description: This file defines a Drupal plugin class 'ImageUrlFormatter' that formats image fields to display URLs, including methods for configuration, rendering, and cache management.

classes.name: ImageUrlFormatter
classes.description: A Drupal plugin class that formats image fields to output URLs, with configurable image styles and cache management.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the formatter with dependencies like image style storage and current user.

methods.name: defaultSettings
methods.description: Returns default configuration settings for the formatter.

methods.name: settingsForm
methods.description: Builds the configuration form for the formatter, allowing selection of image styles.

methods.name: settingsSummary
methods.description: Provides a summary of current formatter settings for display.

methods.name: viewElements
methods.description: Generates the renderable elements for each image, producing URLs with cacheability metadata.
